About & methods

Built by Jonno Millar to turn the numbers behind the points into captain, transfer and chip decisions. Explore the published squad, compare mini-league results, or use Scout to find and compare players.

Player statistics come from the public Fantasy Premier League API, including Opta's expected goals and expected assists. Their sum, expected goal involvement (xGI), describes the quality of chances a player takes and creates. Fixtures, market odds and predicted line-ups inform the analysis.

Projections are estimates. Snapshots refresh on a best-effort schedule.

Read about the data and approach ↗

Snapshot: 12 Nov 2026, 14:41 UTC. Advice uses your last published squad and bank, not changes made since. Double gameweeks are not planned.

The plan · GW11–18

8 WEEKS, MAPPED.

4 free transfersEach week: best XI from your 15, captain twice, bench by its chance of coming on (all of it on Bench Boost week). Roll, or one or two moves a week. Each move must clear 3 points on top of any 4-point hit; hits only for an urgent move this week. A banked free transfer at the end is worth 1.5. Later weeks count for less. Cheap bench slots stay cheap unless a two-move restructure moves them. Chips play only when their week beats waiting by 2. Re-planned at every update.
